errors.name: BookNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a book with the given ISBN or ID is not found in the database.

errors.name: AuthorNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an author with the given ID is not found in the database.

errors.name: MemberNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a member with the given ID is not found in the database.

errors.name: LoanNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a loan with the given ID is not found in the database.

errors.name: InvalidLoanStatusError
errors.description: Raised when an invalid status is provided for a loan (must be 'active', 'returned', or 'overdue').

errors.name: DuplicateEmailError
errors.description: Raised when a member with the same email already exists.

errors.name: DatabaseConnectionError
errors.description: Raised when there is an issue connecting to the SQLite database.
